scoring_version: 2026-11-05 Codex 209 (#1 exact no-row delivery, #2 time-mode onset, #3 paired AUROC, #4 window truth, #7 sent-question options)
latency_method: wall clock (time.perf_counter) around the client call of each API request; answers from the identical-request cache are excluded; machine and network of the run

label_windows.truth_basis: window truth: the segment's truth tag when a GT behaviour second lies in (t - window_s, t], else none (E3 run_eval.py window_truth)

scored_population.rule: labelled windows outside excluded and contradictory segments; the same set for selection, state estimation, rule question, forecast and the null controls

segments.help_rule: admissible help after onset (E3 tools/help_rule.py, imported, one implementation for E3 / E5; main 2026-11-05 from labels red team round 3 #1): a display = a visible support opened inside the segment (not at the window ending at the turn start) and kept by the following windows; help = a display shown at some time at or after the onset whose form is admissible then; designated delivery = the same for the designated supports themselves; latency = max(0, open - onset)
segments.help_rule_name: admissible help after onset (visible at or after the onset, opened within the same turn)

old_definition.rule: before 2026-11-05: a new visible admissible offer at or after the onset (a support held at the onset not credited)

C.options: the sent question's options (a support besides none)
